analyst.summary: Ashapura Minechem has grown very fast on the back of its Guinea bauxite operations ramping up, and looks statistically cheap and high-return on the surface. Look closer, though, and the very high one-year growth rate is largely a one-time step-up from a new mine coming online rather than a repeatable pace, and a large share of the company's loans, advances and investments sit with related overseas entities that shareholders are being asked to approve further transactions with this month - governance points we think are worth a closer look before treating the current growth rate as fully clean.
